title: Trump Says Iran Ceasefire Is Over After Strait Attacks
summary: President Donald Trump declared the June memorandum of understanding ceasefire with Iran over after strikes on commercial ships and regional facilities.
agreement: President Donald Trump declared the interim ceasefire with Iran over during the NATO summit in Ankara.
disagreement: The United States and Iran disagree about responsibility for the breakdown and the path back to diplomacy.

perspectives.title: Trump rejects talks, responds to Iranian aggression
perspectives.summary: Trump declared he does not intend to resume negotiations with Iran.
perspectives.quote: U.S. forces are holding Iran accountable for unwarranted aggression that continues to endanger innocent lives

perspectives.title: Trump's rejection of talks deepens the collapse of the Iran ceasefire
perspectives.summary: With talks off the table, the ceasefire has fully unravelled.
perspectives.quote: The Strait of Hormuz will remain shut until the US ended its acts of aggression

title: Texas Hill Country Faces Flash Flood Warnings as Abbott Declares Disaster
summary: Emergency crews respond as rising water threatens communities across the Texas Hill Country.
agreement: Officials across the political spectrum agree that flooding has caused widespread damage.
disagreement: Outlets differ on the role of infrastructure and the speed of the response.

title: Trump administration plans to rescind rule blocking logging on national forest lands
summary: A proposed change would reshape forest management and expand logging access on public lands.
agreement: The proposal could affect large areas of national forest and local economies.
disagreement: Coverage diverges on environmental costs, wildfire risk and economic benefits.

title: Trump axes Biden-era lobbying restrictions
summary: The action erases rules that restricted former officials from engaging in shadow lobbying.
agreement: The executive action changes ethics rules for political appointees.
disagreement: Sources disagree about whether the changes improve accountability or remove safeguards.

title: U.S. Bank Regulators Warn on Lending Risks for Unauthorized Immigrants
summary: Regulators issued new guidance on lending risk, compliance and financial access.
agreement: Banks face increased pressure to document lending decisions and risk controls.
disagreement: Outlets differ on the effects for borrowers and lenders.
